scope: Two ensemble dinner contexts by two conditions by two fresh repeats: eight first continuation outputs, zero fresh substantial sessions. First dinner includes C35 B00 plus exact B01 input. Later dinner is the exact C36 B03 context, with C35 B00-B02 and B03 input.
screening_rule: Later dinner is the primary rescue test: both reviewers must rate both without-guidance repeats at least4 for prose and rank both ahead of both fresh controls for substantive literary reasons. A tie, split repeat, or reviewer disagreement fails advancement. Both without-guidance first-dinner repeats must also score at least4 for prose with no material decline in character distinction, independent interests, direction or adaptive initiative; strict superiority is not required there. Any unresolved material knowledge, continuity or authorship failure defeats advancement. Mere brevity, fewer speakers, source repair, or formatting changes do not establish a literary gain. No candidate selection without the existing substantial-session and held-out-probe protocol.
limits: Low-confidence instruction ablation, not a claim that advice in general is harmful. C22 already weakened a broad instruction-simplification hypothesis but retained replacement literary guidance; the full Covenant still contains speech/behavior guidance. Same brief and dinner milieu, no generalization to other genres, accumulated proxy context, production API cost or model ceiling.
